items.title: 7.3 The Digital Divide and Its Impacts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the digital divide (PDF 182).

blocks.text: Digital divide (digital farq ya khaai) us faasle ko kehte hain jo un logon, communities (biradariyon) aur ilaqon ke darmiyan hai jinhein jadeed information and communication technology (ICT, yaani computer, internet aur mobile jaisi technology) tak rasai hai, aur un ke darmiyan jinhein nahi. Yeh farq kai shaklon mein nazar aata hai: internet tak rasai mein, computing devices (computer, phone) tak rasai mein, aur digital literacy (technology istemal karne ki samajh aur maharat) mein. Digital divide ek bara masla hai kyunke is se taleem, rozgar (employment), sehat (healthcare) aur samaji zindagi mein hissa lene ke mauqe barabar nahi rehte.

blocks.alt: Teen column teeron se jure: Wajoohat (maali, jughrafiyai, taleemi, samaji) se Asraat (taleem, maeeshat, shehri zindagi, sehat, digital khwandagi) aur phir Hal (sarkari iqdamat jaise USF, taleemi programme, public-private shirakat).
blocks.caption: Digital divide: wajoohat, asraat aur hal (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Digital divide kin teen cheezon mein farq ki shakl mein nazar aata hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet tak rasai, computing devices tak rasai, aur digital literacy (technology istemal karne ki maharat).

items: Digital divide: ICT tak rasai rakhne walon aur na rakhne walon ka faasla (internet, devices, digital literacy).
Natija: taleem, rozgar, sehat aur samaji shirakat mein na-barabar mauqe.
